# mergewf_audit_log_events (Data Source)

Reads `GET /api/v1/audit-log-events` from Merge Workforce. Pagination is automatic for list endpoints. API filters use snake_case attribute names.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mergewf_audit_log_events" "example" {
}

output "result" {
  value = jsondecode(data.mergewf_audit_log_events.example.result_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `actor_user_id` (String) API query parameter `actor_user_id`.
- `cursor` (String) API query parameter `cursor`.
- `event_type` (String) API query parameter `event_type`.
- `limit` (Number) API query parameter `limit`. Page size, not a cap on total returned results.
- `since` (String) API query parameter `since`.
- `until` (String) API query parameter `until`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable hash of the request path and filters.
- `result_json` (String) API response encoded as JSON. For list endpoints this is a JSON array containing all matching results across every page. Use jsondecode to consume it. SCIM discovery endpoints retain their response envelopes.
